title: 第九章 炼器炼个狗铃铛
slug: 纨绔女修四处撩绿茶狼崽黑化了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

苍岚尾巴瞬间僵直，又强迫自己放松下来。

她察觉了什么？她到底知道多少？

萧姚笑眯眯地把手又往苍岚脸前伸了伸。

“装傻？捏坏姐姐的小蜜蜂之前，你在看什么？”

哦？僵住了？看来他的玉笺，的确不简单。

苍岚亮晶晶的眸子暗了下去，氲上一层淡淡的委屈。

“这是我在入门前捡到的，我觉得应该是先人传承，可我不会用……”

“姐姐是不是也觉得，半妖不配修炼？”

苍岚垂下眼帘，狼耳可怜兮兮地趴在头顶，把手伸进怀里，摸出一块古朴的白玉笺，双手捧着举过头顶，姿态卑微又顺从。

“如果姐姐不喜欢，以后苍岚不碰就是了。”

萧姚抬手接过，随意抛了抛。

苍岚的视线黏在上边，也跟着玉笺上下游移。

萧姚低头，对上苍岚紧张的视线，安抚性地笑了笑，旋即五指猛地收拢，用灵力一震！

白玉笺碎成几片，从萧姚指缝间坠落。

苍岚看着地上的玉笺残骸，一时之间有些失语。

她竟不好奇玉笺的内容？那她索要玉笺又是为了什么？

萧姚有些嫌弃地将手心残留的玉屑拍落，揉了揉半折的狼耳，不以为意道：

“你拿了别人的东西，我很不喜欢。不就是传承玉笺嘛，过两天我去给你拿更好的。”

“小狼，别什么破烂都往家里捡。以后你需要什么就跟姐姐讲，姐姐给你找最顶级的。”

这……这是重点吗？！

苍岚怔愣地看着眼前张阖的双唇，听着从中吐出的理所应当的话语，声音发干地应下：

“苍岚都听姐姐的，就是……又给姐姐添麻烦了。”

萧姚无所谓地横躺在椅子上，两腿嚣张地挂在扶手上晃荡：

“嗐，千金难买我乐意。”

“行了，葛叔他应该快来了，你先去收拾自己的屋子吧，别跟他打照面，省得他又欺负你。”

苍岚恭敬退下，心情复杂地去了侧屋。

他真的搞不懂这位纨绔大小姐到底在想什么。他也区分不清，她嘴里到底有几句情话，几句实话。

毕竟这些话，从来没有人对他讲过。

萧姚目送苍岚离开，脸上的笑意越来越淡。

她从椅子里爬起来坐好，收敛起纨绔做派，戳了戳025：

【统子，看出什么名堂没有？】

025的电子音有点纠结：

【宿主，你好像猜错了，不是实锤。】

【玉笺里是空的！什么都没有，干净得跟被格式化了一样。】

萧姚用手指点了点下巴，若有所思。

比起他拿着空玉笺鼓捣，她更倾向于小狼崽子是谨慎地把玉笺清空了。

难怪拿出来的时候那么果断，感情是在诈她啊！

此地无银，更可疑了。

【统子，我先重点攻略苍岚，你那边随时留意任务刷新情况。】

还剩360天19小时，时间不等人。砸钱没用，那她就开始攻心。

【OK的！就剩这最后两天，我说什么也得给你盯紧了！】

Page (1/3)

Cang Lan's tail stiffened for an instant, and then she forced herself to relax.

What did she notice?How much does she know?

Xiao Yao smiled and stretched his hand in front of Cang Lan's face.

"Pretending to be stupid? What were you looking at before you crushed your sister's little bee?"

Oh?Stiffened?It seems that his jade note is indeed not simple.

Cang Lan's bright eyes darkened, filled with a layer of slight grievance.

"I picked this up before I entered the house. I think it should be passed down from my ancestors, but I don't know how to use it..."

"Does my sister also think that half-demon is not worthy of cultivation?"

Cang Lan lowered her eyes, with her wolf ears lying pitifully on top of her head. She reached into her arms and took out a piece of simple white jade paper. She held it with both hands and raised it above her head, with a humble and submissive posture.

"If sister doesn't like it, just don't touch Cang Lan from now on."

Xiao Yao raised his hand to take it and tossed it casually.

Cang Lan's eyes were glued to it, and she also followed the jade note as it moved up and down.

Xiao Yao lowered his head, met Cang Lan's nervous gaze, smiled reassuringly, and then suddenly tightened his fingers and shook with spiritual power!

The white jade paper broke into several pieces and fell from Xiao Yao's fingers.

Cang Lan looked at the remains of the jade paper on the ground and was speechless for a moment.

She wasn't curious about the contents of the jade note?Then why did she ask for the jade note?

Xiao Yao patted the remaining jade shavings off his palm with some disgust, rubbed the half-broken wolf ears, and said indifferently:

"I don't like it when you take other people's things. Isn't it just the inheritance jade note? I'll get you a better one in two days."

"Little Wolf, don't just pick up all the junk at home. If you need anything from now on, just tell your sister, and she will find the best for you."

Is this... is this the point?!

Cang Lan stared blankly at the open and closed lips in front of her eyes, listening to the words that should be spoken from them, and responded with a dry voice:

"Cang Lan listens to her sister, but... she has caused trouble to her again."

Xiao Yao lay on the chair indifferently, his legs hanging arrogantly on the armrest:

"Hey, I'm happy that money can't buy."

"Okay, Uncle Ge should be here soon. You go and clean up your house first. Don't meet him, lest he bully you again."

Cang Lan bowed respectfully and went to the side room with mixed emotions.

He really couldn't understand what this dandy young lady was thinking.He couldn't tell the difference between how many words of love and how many truths she had in her mouth.

After all, no one had ever said these words to him.

Xiao Yao watched Cang Lan leave, the smile on his face getting weaker and weaker.

She got up from the chair and sat down, restrained her playfulness, and poked 025:

[Tongzi, do you see any tricks?】

025’s electronic sound is a bit confusing:

[Host, you seem to have guessed wrong. It’s not true.】

[The jade note is empty!There is nothing, it is as clean as if it has been formatted.】

Xiao Yao tapped his chin with his finger, thoughtfully.

Rather than him tinkering with the empty jade paper, she preferred that the little wolf cub carefully emptied the jade paper.

No wonder she was so decisive when she took it out. Her feelings were deceiving her!

There is no silver here, which makes it even more suspicious.

[Tongzi, I will focus on conquering Canglan first. You should pay attention to the task refresh situation at any time.】

There are 360 days and 19 hours left, time waits for no one.Spending money didn't work, so she started attacking her heart.

【OK!In these last two days, I have to keep an eye on you no matter what I say!】
